verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's docs include code examples across guides (function calling, JSON mode, streaming, rate limits) with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible snippets, but there is no evidence of an interactive, in-browser 'try it now' API console or runnable playground — just static documented examples.  missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API console/sandbox, live runnable code execution in docs, independent confirmation of an interactive reference experience.
